posts.title: CloudNativePG reaches CNCF Incubation: another rung on the ladder

posts.title: CNPG Recipe 28 - Generated and rotating PostgreSQL user passwords in CloudNativePG 1.31
posts.description: A first look at what CloudNativePG 1.31 will bring to PostgreSQL credentials: a DatabaseRole can now generate its own password, keep it in a Secret the operator owns, shape it with criteria and rotate it on a schedule, with PostgreSQL enforcing the lifetime through VALID UNTIL . posts.title: CNPG Recipe 27 - Running OpenBao on Kubernetes with a CloudNativePG PostgreSQL backend
posts.description: A walkthrough of running OpenBao on Kubernetes with CloudNativePG as its PostgreSQL storage backend. Every layer of this stack is open source, with no vendor lock-in: Kubernetes and CloudNativePG are both CNCF projects, authenticated entirely over TLS client certificates via the 1.30 DatabaseRole CRD, with no passwords anywhere in the stack. Co-authored with Rob Kenefeck from ControlPlane .
